root_idea.summary: A performed act or deed, especially purposeful action and work.
root_idea.development: The root's central notion extends from doing and working to deeds, workers and agents, employing or causing work, mutual dealing, wages, and specialized tools or products associated with work.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Feminine active-participle form is subsumed under the masculine participial citation headword عَامِلٌ; its feminine Quranic use remains represented by the supplied example.
Active participle citation form for the Quranic worker and administrator senses.

senses.definition: To do, perform, act, work, or render service.
senses.usage_conditions: An active Form I verb for purposeful action or work; it is used of both beneficial and blameworthy acts and may take a deed, task, or other object.

senses.definition: To make, manufacture, construct, or produce something.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive use in which the object is a thing made, wrought, manufactured, or constructed.

senses.definition: One who works, labors, serves, acts, or performs; a worker or doer.
senses.usage_conditions: The feminine form عَامِلَةٌ is included in this participial entry; the Quran uses the form adjectivally of one engaged in labor.

senses.definition: An administrator or agent managing affairs, especially an officer who collects or administers alms.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional administrative use; in the Quran, الْعَامِلِينَ عَلَيْهَا denotes those appointed over the collection or administration of alms.

senses.definition: An intentional deed or action, whether good or bad.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses it for purposeful deeds and actions, including righteous and evil conduct; it is distinguished lexically from an act that occurs without intention.

senses.definition: Work, labor, service, or an undertaken task.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote work or service as an activity or body of work, not only an individual deed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To officiate in the collection or administration of a poor-rate or similar public duty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs with عَلَى in the cited construction, as in serving over the collection of alms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act upon something, have an effect or impression on it, or work toward its destruction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A constructional use with an affected object; examples include a weapon having effect and laboring to destroy someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To govern a word syntactically and produce a particular grammatical ending.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical use, especially with a governing expression said to produce nominative, accusative, genitive, or similar inflection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of lightning, to continue; of a she-camel or similar mount, to move swiftly or become brisk and active.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Specialized uses applied to natural phenomena or swift movement of an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of money or expenditure, to pass away or be spent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use describing money that is expended or does not remain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appoint someone governor or official over a province, city, or people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II causative/appointive construction, commonly with عَلَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone his pay or salary for work, service, or agency.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II employment and remuneration use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deal, transact, or conduct business with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III reciprocal or relational use, especially in buying and selling and similar dealings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bargain or contract with someone for work, including an arrangement to cultivate land or trees for a share of the produce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A work-contract use; the cultivation arrangement is a conventional regional application of the term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or cause someone to work, labor, serve, act, or produce something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV causative use with a person or a thing as the object of the caused activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To employ or use one's judgment, opinion, intellect, tongue, instrument, or implement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use meaning to put a faculty or tool to work; it includes applying one's understanding to consider consequences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten or urge a riding camel or other mount.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV causative use applied to driving an animal onward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a set phrase, to occupy oneself intensely with performing a deed or course of action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic Form IV expression describing sustained occupation with a specified action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To thrust or pierce with the working part of a spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV weapon construction involving the عَامِل of the spear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undergo fatigue or difficulty and strive, labor, or toil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V expresses exertion or strenuous effort for or in a task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deal with one another in buying and selling or other transactions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI reciprocal dealing; it can also describe using a currency or object in commercial transactions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To work actively, independently or for another, especially by applying one's own labor or tools.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII depicts a person occupied in work or service, whether for himself or another and with or without implements.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To labor to earn or gain sustenance, including by cultivating and managing land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form VIII use for applying one's labor to livelihood or agricultural work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To employ or use a person for work or service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use is reported as possibly post-classical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask, require, or desire someone to work, serve, or act for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X expresses seeking or requiring another's service.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a person or thing to use, including employing someone in an office, using a garment or building material, or using a pretext or condition as a mask.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X extends from employing a person to making practical use of an object or assumed state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Striving, laboring, or persisting in work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal specialization emphasizing continued exertion or holding on to a task.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In compounds, one who performs another's work; in ابنُ عَمَلٍ, a strong man; and in related expressions, people characterized by active travel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are fixed idiomatic or compound uses rather than the ordinary standalone noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In بَنُو عَمَلٍ, people who travel on foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed plural expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cultivation or agricultural management of palm trees, land, or similar property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A possessive construction such as عَمَلُ النَّخْلِ or عَمَلُ الأَرْضِ specifies the field of work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An administrative office, governorship, collecting office, agency, employment, or management of another's affairs and property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized institutional sense of work or office, including public administration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A province or territory placed under a governor appointed by a sovereign.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional administrative use of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a man, having work, disposed or adapted by nature to labor, or making much gain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival epithet describing aptitude or habitual capacity for work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of lightning, continuing or continual.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use applied to persistent lightning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, brisk, light, active, or swift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal epithet or noun for a naturally active she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Theft, treachery, perfidy, or unfaithfulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This feminine noun is reported as used only in relation to evil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of working, serving, doing, acting, or making.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe the manner or method by which gain is obtained, including a bad or corrupt mode of gain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The internal state or condition of a person in relation to evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized ethical or dispositional use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing done, performed, or made; a completed product or action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A result noun, including something that has been produced or carried out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Practical, factitious, artificial, or relating to actual operation rather than theory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in opposition to عَلْمِيٌّ in the cited lexical contrast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiom, to exceed ordinary bounds in annoying, reviling, or harassing someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed intensified expression with a specialized object and construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The briskness, lightness, activity, or quickness of a she-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hire, pay, or recompense received for work, labor, or service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A remuneration noun for the worker's compensation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The state of being occupied or having work or service to perform.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It denotes employment or occupation as the opposite of idleness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who does much work or labor, strives persistently, or continues at work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjectival form describing habitual or abundant exertion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the plural, a manual worker, especially one working with the hands in clay, building, digging, or similar occupations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural use of the active participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of oxen, camels, or similar animals, one employed in plowing, treading grain, drawing water, or other labor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural عَوَامِلُ is used for working animals and beasts of burden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part of a spear immediately below or next to the head, or its forepart exclusive of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical weapon term; authorities differ on the exact portion and whether the spearhead itself is included.

other_classical_meanings.definition: As a substantive, a leg of a beast, horse, or similar animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separate nominal use from the feminine active participle; its plural is associated with عَوَامِلُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A conspicuous, well-traveled road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a road marked by travel or use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Done, made, or completed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinary passive-participial sense of the derived noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a beverage or wine, containing milk, honey, and snow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare traditional descriptive use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ass, having had its testicles extracted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare specialized animal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, employed in work, labor, or service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial adjective applied to a working animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An excellent, strong, light, or swift camel; the feminine form specifically denotes a she-camel of this type.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These forms are also treated as substantives for the animals; يَوْمُ اليَعْمَلَةِ is recorded as a named day of conflict.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Core doing, making, alms-service, and effect branches are represented.
Fixed phrase about occupying oneself with a deed.
Employing people and using objects or pretexts.
Core noun, compounds, cultivation, and administrative branches.
Mode or manner of working and gain.
Internal condition in relation to evil.
Explicit synonym of the Quran-attested deed/action noun.
Fixed idiom of exceeding bounds in harassment.
State of being occupied with work.
Active participle, manual-worker, and working-animal branches.
Substantive عاملة meaning an animal's legs.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the spear term.

cautions: The Quran-only feminine form عَامِلَةٌ is accounted for under the normalized active-participle headword عَامِلٌ; its separate classical substantive use for an animal's leg is retained under other classical meanings.

The ordinary Quranic verb and noun senses cover purposeful action, work, and making; specialized administrative, grammatical, animal, weapon, idiomatic, and technical branches remain separate where the lexical evidence requires them.
